test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Himalayas include the highest mountains in the world and feed almost 20% of the earth’s population.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**the**" before "**Himalayas**."
 
• Proper nouns that refer to mountain ranges, rivers, and some other geographical features typically require the definite article "the" before them.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**The Himalayas include**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"**The Himalayas include** the highest mountains in the world and feed almost 20% of the earth's population."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "almost 20% of the earth's population."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "highest mountains in"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "the world and feed"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
